ofertas.publicada: Offer published. People on the list can put themselves forward until {vence}.
ofertas.publicada_antes: The offer was already published with this same request.
ofertas.vacio: This list has no published offers.
ofertas.directo_por_politica: The list's policy sends this post to a direct call
ofertas.espera_anterior: Will be called once the previous post is settled
ofertas.confirmar_llamamiento_directo: Move post {plaza} to a direct call?
ofertas.confirmar_sin_respuesta: Record that no. {orden} did not reply in time for post {plaza}?
ofertas.hecho_llamamiento_directo: Post {plaza} moves to a direct call.
ofertas.error_carga: The offers could not be loaded. Press Retry.
ofertas.error_403: Your session cannot manage this list's offers.
ofertas.error_409_clave_divergente: That request was already used with other data. Check the form.
ofertas.error_409_oferta_ya_resuelta: This offer was settled earlier and no longer accepts changes.
ofertas.error_409_plazo_abierto: The deadline to put forward is still open.
ofertas.error_409_propuesta_cambiada: The post changed while you were viewing it. Check the updated situation.
ofertas.error_409_respuesta_abierta: The person still has time to reply.
ofertas.error_409_politica_sin_plazas: This list's offer policy does not allow several posts. Set up its "Posts" section and publish again.
ofertas.error_503_plazo_no_configurado: This list's offer policy has no deadline: the offer cannot be published.
ofertas.error_generico: The operation could not be completed. Check the offers before trying again.

politica_plazas.llamada_simultanea: At the same time, as many people as free posts
politica_plazas.tras_renuncia: If someone declines or does not reply
politica_plazas.tras_renuncia_siguiente_en_orden: The next person is called for that post
politica_plazas.tras_renuncia_llamamiento_directo: That post moves to a direct call
